GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 004.03 (5 Feb 46) ESS-EX
(SCAPIN-704)
APO 500
5 February 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Publication of Reports on Specified Companies.
1. Reference is made to your memorandum, C. L. O. No, 412 ( 2.3), subject: “Publication of Reports on Specified Companies”, 27 January 1946.
2. This Headquarters has no objection to the proposed compilation and publication of the industrial and commercial data proposed in above memorandum, provided that no reference is made in such publication to this Headquarters
3. It is directed that the Toyo Keizai Shimpo Sha set aside fifty (50) copies of above publication, when published for the use of this Headquarters
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH,
Brigadier General, AGD,
Adjutant General.
